The deposit insurance system has a very weak legal framework based on

DCGC bylaws. The DCGC lacks any IT system to administer the system and the

regulatory framework for deposit insurance is incomplete. DPC1 supported the approval

by the MoF of a draft bill (the DCGF Bill), prepared with the assistance of the World Bank,

IMF, and DFID, which would provide the legal framework for the deposit insurance

scheme, which presently operates within a weak framework of regulations and bylaws

rather than specific legislation. The new deposit insurance system will follow the "pay-
